title: Program-Aided Patchable Skill Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2611.14019v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agent skills have emerged as an effective means of enabling LLM agents to solve complex, interactive tasks by encoding reusable knowledge without modifying model parameters. Recent approaches further improve skill adaptation by distilling reusable experience from agent execution trajectories and evolving skills based on downstream task feedback. However, existing methods primarily represent skills as natural language documents, intertwining procedural logic with descriptive knowledge and making skills difficult to maintain and evolve. To address this limitation, we propose PASE (Program-Aided Patchable Skill Evolution), a program-aided framework that iteratively evolves skills by associating them with executable programs. translated_title: 程序辅助的可补丁技能演化
translated_abstract: 智能体技能已成为一种有效手段，通过编码可复用知识而无需修改模型参数，使LLM智能体能够解决复杂的交互式任务。最近的方法通过从智能体执行轨迹中提炼可复用经验，并基于下游任务反馈来演化技能，进一步提升了技能适应能力。然而，现有方法主要以自然语言文档的形式表示技能，将程序性逻辑与描述性知识交织在一起，使得技能难以维护和演化。为解决这一局限，我们提出了PASE（程序辅助的可补丁技能演化），一个通过将技能与可执行程序相关联来迭代演化技能的程序辅助框架。与先前主要用自然语言编码轨迹经验的方法不同，PASE将可复用的程序性逻辑分离为可编辑的程序，从而能够对可执行组件进行针对性更新……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出PASE框架，通过将智能体技能中的可复用程序性逻辑分离为可编辑的可执行程序（而非自然语言文档），实现技能的可维护性、可补丁化与针对性迭代演化。
en_tdlr: PASE is a program-aided framework that separates reusable procedural logic of agent skills into editable executable programs, enabling patchable and targeted iterative skill evolution.
